_note: v2 hook overrides for la Maison de Couture (B62_couture). Source hooks are kept where the painting shows them; these replace hooks whose painted scene differs (no text or numbers, no weapons).

fr_charme_noun.why: The French word sounds like English CHARM and means the same; the CHARM bracelet is the literal picture.

fr_apparence_noun.why: The painting shows a lady checking her own appearance rather than a parent and son.

fr_parure_noun.why: The cat duchess was repainted as a human duchess.

fr_admiration_noun.why: The painting shows two admiring geese, no swan.

fr_allure_noun.why: The horse is a toy figurine on the theater's edge.

fr_elegance_noun.why: The runway is painted as a red carpet.

fr_asperite_noun.why: A boy in a smart suit trips over the rock.

fr_plaine_noun.why: The plain is the painted backdrop behind the figures.

fr_exotisme_noun.why: One hat is painted in the cabinet.

fr_scrupule_noun.why: The pool is the round mirror stand under the puppy.

fr_variete_noun.why: The hats hang on the stand next to the giraffe.

fr_vecu_noun.why: Grandpa sits on the album rather than flipping it.

fr_ruse_noun.why: RUE gives the sound "REWZ"; hiding behind a curtain to fool people is the RUSE (trick).

fr_harmonie_noun.why: The singing cats were repainted as girls.

fr_revelation_noun.why: The mouse and the cat model were repainted as a page boy and a lady.

fr_compliment_noun.why: The hedgehog was repainted as a shy boy.

fr_aubaine_noun.why: The placeholder banknote was repainted as a gold coin.

fr_elegant_adj.why: The flamingo standing on one LEG carries the sound (ay-lay-GAHN); a natural flamingo with nothing worn.

fr_look_noun.why: The name LUKE is the sound-alike; a boy replaces the pug in clothes.

fr_choix_noun.why: "SHOE-AH" gives the sound "SHWA"; picking one shoe of two is a CHOICE.

fr_chic_adj.why: CHEEK gives the sound "SHEEK"; her tailored suit makes her CHIC (stylish).

fr_epingle_noun.why: RECS handoff: moved from banque/guichet to the couture atelier; the painted scene is a seamstress, not the source's old tailor with a rosette.

fr_retrecir_verb.why: Étroit = narrow → rétrécir = to shrink, to narrow. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_marees/pull_retreci into couture/atelier; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_froisser_verb.why: Froisser = to crumple, to crease (ne froisse pas ta chemise !); also to offend, to hurt someone's feelings. RED beret = regular -er. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_habitudes/chaussons into couture/atelier; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_coudre_verb.why: Could-ruh → coudre = to sew (elle coud un bouton). Irregular: GOLD beret.
